uncited: - **Input**: Source data in standard linear (row-major) order; swizzle pattern parameters (tile sizes, bit interleaving rules).
The method relies on bit masks and offset variables.
- `offs_x`, `offs_y`: 32-bit unsigned integers representing the byte offset within the swizzled memory space for the current x and y coordinates.
- `x_mask`, `y_mask`: 32-bit unsigned integers where bits are set to 1 at positions corresponding to the x and y coordinate bits in the swizzled address, respectively.
Bits corresponding to "holes" (reserved for other coordinates or tile indices) are 0.
- `incr_y`: 32-bit unsigned integer representing the byte increment required to move from one tile row to the next in non-power-of-2 layouts.
- Reset source pointer to the start of the current row.
- Set destination line base: $dest\_line = dest + offs\_y$.
- **Inner loop tile size**: Depends on cache line size and texture format.
- **Non-square power-of-2 textures**: Straight Morton order swizzling only works well with square dimensions.
